title: How differences in economics, public policy, and cultural patterns could explain greater pessimism about AI in the West than in Asia and emerging economies (Gillian Tett/Financial Times)
summary: Gillian Tett / Financial Times: How differences in economics, public policy, and cultural patterns could explain greater pessimism about AI in the West than in Asia and emerging economies — Voter hostility to Big Tech helped shape the US midterms, and similar fears are spreading through the west.
